I've been a practicing urologist for 22 years. I've prescribed every ED medication on the market—Viagra, Cialis, Levitra, you name it.

- 90% of men report harder, more reliable erections
- No side effects, no headaches, no dependency
But thousands of men—including some of my own patients—were asking about it. So I investigated.

uniqueMechanism.headline: What I Found: The Science
body: The Circulation Mechanism Is Legitimate
Here's what shocked me:
Capsaicin—the active compound in cayenne pepper—triggers nitric oxide production through the exact same pathway as Viagra using TRPV1 Receptors.
But there's a critical difference:
Viagra forces blood vessels open temporarily.
You take it, it works for 4-6 hours, then wears off. Your circulation gets no better. In fact, many studies suggest it may worsen over time because you're not addressing the root cause.
Capsaicin actually repairs endothelial function.

The endothelium is the inner lining of your blood vessels. When it's damaged (from age, diet, inflammation), blood flow to your penis deteriorates. Capsaicin restores this tissue, improving circulation permanently.
The Clinical Data Was Real

- 89.7% reported significant improvement in erection quality within 30 days
- Average time to noticeable results: 12-18 days
- Zero serious adverse events across 1,200+ users
- 94.3% satisfaction rate vs 71% for prescription pills
The difference?
Lora Capsaicin Power Power isn't masking the problem.
It's healing it.

body: The Dependency Problem
You'll need pills forever. Your circulation never improves. In fact, some research suggests it may deteriorate faster because the underlying endothelial damage progresses unchecked.
The Cost Problem
Brand Viagra: $60-140 per pill
Generic Sildenafil: $2-8 per pill
Most men use 8-12 pills per month = $200-400/month for life.
The Side Effect Problem
68% of Viagra users experience headaches, flushing, vision changes, or indigestion. Many stop using it entirely because the side effects outweigh the benefits.
The Heart Risk Problem
New research shows men with high blood pressure who take Viagra have significantly elevated cardiovascular mortality risk. Your ED pills might be silently damaging your heart.
The Tolerance Problem
Many men report needing higher doses over time. First 25mg works. Then 50mg. Then 100mg. Then... nothing.
One patient told me:
'I knew I was in trouble when 100mg stopped working. My doctor wanted to try injections next. That's when I started looking for alternatives.'
